name: qualify-flowcell-claim-for-engineering
verb-phrase: qualifying a FlowCell claim for Engineering
description: Use after a FlowCell assay to decide whether the result is bounded enough to become an Engineering input.
preconditions: exact tested configuration and raw evidence resolve
analysis, uncertainty, controls, failures and deviations are available
postconditions: claim status is one of qualified, qualified-with-bounds, not-qualified, or contradicted
operating envelope, comparator, uncertainty, replication, confounders and prohibited extrapolations are explicit
Engineering can identify what it may and may not infer
input-shape: FlowCell scientific/configuration evidence appropriate to the named procedure
output-shape: Typed FlowCell scientific evidence packet described by the postconditions
